description: Buddy Phase 10 — Execution Intelligence & Causal Learning. Phase 9 closed feedback loops. Phase 10 adds causal learning (exit reason extraction), portfolio optimization (pair affinity), model health tracking (gate degradation), time seasonality, per-agent attribution, and macro risk filtering. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP BRAINSTORMING/RESEARCHING AND IMPROVING. DONT ASK FOR EVERY COMMAND, JUST DO. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Exit reason extraction and journal enrichment
userStories.description: Systematically record WHY trades exited (TP-hit, SL-hit, trailing-stop, timeout, manual). Enrich journal entries with exit_reason field. Enables causal RL: distinguish 'good rule bad luck' from 'bad rule good luck'.
acceptanceCriteria: execution.py adds exit_reason field to journal close records
Exit reasons: tp_hit, sl_hit, trailing_stop, breakeven_stop, timeout, manual_close
Detect exit reason by comparing close_price to SL/TP levels
online_rl.py can segment weight updates by exit reason
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Exit reason detection added to sync_closed_trades_rl via _determine_exit_reason. Classifies: tp_hit, sl_hit, trailing_stop, breakeven_stop, timeout, manual_close. Compares close_price to SL/TP with 2-pip tolerance. exit_reason field added to outcome_data.

userStories.title: Trade pair affinity matrix for portfolio optimization
userStories.description: Build historical co-occurrence matrix tracking which pairs win/lose together. Use affinity scores to recommend optimal pair combinations and avoid negatively-correlated pair sets.
acceptanceCriteria: New class PairAffinityTracker in src/scanner/automation/pair_affinity.py
Computes co-win rate, co-loss rate for all pair combinations from journal
Persists 27x27 affinity matrix to trained_data/models/pair_affinity_matrix.json
get_affinity_score(pair_a, pair_b) returns float -1 to 1
portfolio_optimizer.py uses affinity to recommend pair sets
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: PairAffinityTracker created in pair_affinity.py. Builds 27x27 co-occurrence matrix from overlapping trades. get_affinity_score() returns -1 to 1. get_best_companions() returns top diversification pairs. Persists to pair_affinity_matrix.json.

userStories.title: Gate model degradation detector with fallback heuristics
userStories.description: Track per-gate model accuracy during live inference. When gate accuracy drops below 50% over rolling window, substitute with simple heuristic fallback to prevent silent degradation.
acceptanceCriteria: GateEvaluator tracks per-gate rolling accuracy (last 50 predictions)
Persists gate accuracy to trained_data/models/gate_accuracy.json
When gate accuracy < 50% over 50+ samples: switch to heuristic fallback
Fallback heuristics defined per gate type
Gate health logged to observation_log (gate_degradation category)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: GateHealthTracker in gate_health.py. Rolling 50-prediction window per gate. Degradation detected when accuracy < 50%. Fallback heuristics defined per gate type. Logs gate_degradation to observation_log.

userStories.title: Hour-of-day seasonality extraction and confidence adjustment
userStories.description: Analyze per-pair hour-of-day win rates from journal. Apply confidence multiplier to adjust position sizing based on historically profitable/unprofitable hours per pair.
acceptanceCriteria: New class SeasonalityTracker in src/scanner/automation/seasonality.py
Extracts hour-of-day win rate per pair from trade_journal_rl.json
Persists to trained_data/models/hour_seasonality.json
get_hour_modifier(pair, hour) returns float 0.7-1.3
Wired into engine.py _scan_pair to adjust confidence by hour
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: SeasonalityTracker in seasonality.py. Per-pair hour-of-day win rate extraction from journal. get_hour_modifier() returns 0.70-1.30. Wired into engine.py analysis_context as seasonality_modifier. Persists to hour_seasonality.json.

userStories.title: Per-agent contribution attribution with pair-specific tracking
userStories.description: Decompose wins/losses by agent contribution. Track per-pair per-agent win rate to identify domain-specific agent strengths and weaknesses.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentHealthMonitor extended with per-pair metrics tracking
record_outcome() now accepts pair parameter for pair-specific attribution
get_pair_agent_matrix() returns {pair: {agent: {win_rate, trades}}}
Agents with <30% win rate on specific pair get pair-specific decay
Attribution data logged to trained_data/agent_attribution.json
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: AgentHealthMonitor extended with per-pair metrics via _pair_metrics. record_outcome() accepts pair parameter. get_pair_agent_matrix() returns pair-specific win rates. get_pair_specific_decay_rates() gives 3x decay for agents with <30% win rate on specific pairs. save_attribution() persists to agent_attribution.json.

userStories.title: Derived macro stress indicator for position sizing
userStories.description: Compute a macro stress score from FX-derived signals (DXY proxy via USD pairs, volatility regime persistence, spread widening trend). Apply macro_stress_modifier to position sizing during detected stress periods.
acceptanceCriteria: New class MacroStressDetector in src/scanner/automation/macro_stress.py
Computes stress_score from: average USD pair volatility, regime persistence in HIGH/EXTREME, spread widening trend
No external API required — derived from existing OANDA data
get_stress_modifier() returns 0.5-1.0 (stress → reduce sizing)
Wired into engine.py execute_trades analysis_context
Stress events logged to observation_log (macro_stress category)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: MacroStressDetector in macro_stress.py. Composite score from USD volatility, regime persistence, spread widening. get_stress_modifier() returns 0.50-1.0. Wired into engine.py analysis_context and execution.py lot sizing. Logs macro_stress to observation_log.
